name: Fetch
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 2, ranger 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target animal touched
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The target animal’s fangs curve like claws, or it grows opposable talons. For the duration of the spell, the animal can make disarm checks, substituting your caster level for its base attack bonus.
